Required API: public static long[] windowSummary(List<long[]> events, long start, long end, int limit)
Behavior: Reject start greater than end or a negative limit. Select events with timestamps in [start,end), order by timestamp with original order breaking ties, keep only the latest limit, and return (kept count,value sum). Limit zero returns zeros.
Visible example: events (8,5),(3,2),(8,7),(10,99),(6,4), window [3,10), limit 3 returns (3,16).

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static long[] windowSummary(List<long[]>e,long start,long end,int limit){if(start>end||limit<0)return null;var a=new ArrayList<long[]>();for(int i=0;i<e.size();i++){var x=e.get(i);if(x[0]>=start&&x[0]<end)a.add(new long[]{x[0],x[1],i});}a.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(x->x[0]));if(a.size()>limit)a=new ArrayList<>(a.subList(a.size()-limit,a.size()));long s=0;for(var x:a)s+=x[1];return new long[]{a.size(),s};}}
